title: The Closing Figure on a Final Catering Statement
content:
## The figure

The closing figure of a corporate catering service agreement is the amount the client is asked for on the final catering statement when the agreement ends. It applies to a Corporate Catering Service Agreement that the client is bringing to an end.

## How it is made up

The closing figure is the shortfall that falls due on the agreement's spend commitment, then the late charge, then the early-exit charge, then the amount standing unsettled on the agreement, added in that order and rounded to two decimal places only at the end.

## The commitment

The minimum tested against is the minimum annual catering spend printed against the catering service level. The spend counted toward that minimum is what has been invoiced on the agreement in the 12 months ending on the day it closes. The shortfall is the minimum tested against less the spend counted, and never less than nothing. The whole of the shortfall falls due.

## The late charge

No late charge is raised on the closing figure. The late charge is worked out on the amount standing unsettled on the agreement and is held to the late charge ceiling printed against the catering service level, the ceiling applying after the percentage has been taken.

## The early-exit charge

No early-exit charge is raised on the closing figure.

## The balance

The amount standing unsettled on the agreement is carried onto the closing figure in full.

## Worked illustration on hypothetical figures

Take a hypothetical agreement whose service level is printed with a minimum annual catering spend of 42000.00 USD, on which 30000.00 USD has been invoiced in the 12 months ending on the day it closes, and which carries 850.00 USD standing unsettled.

| Component | Hypothetical figure |
| --- | --- |
| Minimum tested against | 42000.00 USD |
| Spend counted | 30000.00 USD |
| Shortfall | 12000.00 USD |
| Shortfall falling due | 12000.00 USD |
| Late charge | 0.00 USD |
| Early-exit charge | 0.00 USD |
| Amount standing unsettled | 850.00 USD |
| Closing figure | 12850.00 USD |

Where the spend counted in that window had instead been 45000.00 USD, the minimum tested against less the spend counted would be a negative quantity; the shortfall is never less than nothing, so it would stand at 0.00 USD and the closing figure would be 850.00 USD.
